title: Core normalized derived reindexing comparisons
statement: Under the strict reindexing data, normalized quotient maps and completion comparisons, there is a derived-data witness carrying the reduction/evaluation, limit/projection, unit, finite-model, and full-limit-model laws. The representative pullback normalization is omitted.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; core strict quotient, finite evaluation, adjunction, and Roos-limit descent.

proof.text: Construct the sectionwise finite and system comparisons from the strict quotient maps. Apply the exact product/Roos strict-limit comparison to obtain the normalized derived limit and projection equations, and transport the ordinary adjunction through localization. Package the five resulting laws as CoreLaws.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5; core strict quotient, finite evaluation, adjunction, and Roos-limit descent.
